2608.19854.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
2608.19854.paper_summary: Large language model agents have made substantial progress in code generation, yet most existing systems assume a predefined repository architecture. This assumption does not hold in zero-to-all code generation, where an agent must construct an entire software project directly from natural-language requirements while maintaining a modular repository architecture throughout development. We present Repo0, a continuous structural evolution framework for zero-to-all code generation. Repo0 maintains an explicit architectural state instantiated as a Dual-Directed-Acyclic-Graph (Dual-DAG), consisting of a requirement-level DAG, a component-level DAG, and their alignment relation. Starting from natural-language requirements, it iteratively evolves component boundaries through structural actions guided by modularity metrics until structural convergence, after which the converged architecture guides test-driven development code generation. We evaluate Repo0 on six real-world repositories from RepoCraft using GPT-5 mini and DeepSeek V3.2. Repo0 achieves the highest Functionality Coverage and Pass Rate across all settings. Compared with RPG, the strongest repository-planning baseline, Repo0 improves Functionality Coverage by up to 20.08 percentage points and Pass Rate by up to 29.74 percentage points. Ablation and structural-evolution analyses further demonstrate the importance of the Dual-DAG architectural state, modularity-guided structural evolution, and explicit structural convergence.
2608.19854.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在程式碼生成方面取得了顯著進展，然而大多數現有系統假設一個預定義的庫架構。這一假設在零到全碼生成中並不成立，因為代理必須直接從自然語言需求構建整個軟體專案，同時在開發過程中保持模組化的庫架構。我們提出了Repo0，一個用於零到全碼生成的持續結構演化框架。Repo0維護一個明確的架構狀態，該狀態被實例化為雙向有向無環圖（Dual-DAG），由需求層級的DAG、組件層級的DAG及其對應關係組成。從自然語言需求開始，它通過結構性行動，根據模組化指標迭代演化組件邊界，直到結構收斂，之後收斂的架構引導測試驅動的開發程式碼生成。我們在六個來自RepoCraft的實際庫上使用GPT-5 mini和DeepSeek V3.2對Repo0進行評估。Repo0在所有設置中實現了最高的功能覆蓋率和通過率。與最強的庫規劃基準RPG相比，Repo0的功能覆蓋率提高了最多20.08個百分點，通過率提高了最多29.74個百分點。消融和結構演化分析進一步證明了雙向有向無環圖架構狀態、模組化引導的結構演化以及明確的結構收斂的重要性。
